comments: Receptor-independent mechanism distinguishes mSUPYNL1 from hSUPYN; broad antiviral potential intriguing but functional significance in vivo remains unclear.

model_io.model: Cell-cell fusion assays; mSUPYNL1 knockout mice; placental tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: mSUPYNL1 suppresses fusion via receptor interference like hSUPYN
hypotheses.result: Rejected; mSUPYNL1 acts independently of receptor usage

hypotheses.hypothesis: mSUPYNL1 has antiviral activity against HTLV-1
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mSUPYNL1 inhibits HTLV-1 Env-dependent syncytium formation

title: Magnoflorine alleviates experimental osteoarthritis and is associated with altered M1- and M2-associated macrophage markers and subchondral bone remodeling
task: Determine magnoflorine's effects on osteoarthritis via macrophage polarization and bone remodeling
key_results: Magnoflorine improves OA in DMM rats: reduced joint degeneration, enhanced subchondral bone stability, improved cartilage morphology; reduced M1 markers, increased M2 markers; reduced ROS, attenuated MAPK/NF-κB, enhanced Nrf2 responses; no cytotoxicity at 25-100 µg/mL in vitro
comments: Multi-target anti-inflammatory/antioxidant profile is promising; sequential causal cascade between ROS-signaling changes and phenotypic outcomes not established.

model_io.model: Rat DMM osteoarthritis model; MC3T3-E1 osteoblasts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnoflorine's anti-OA effects are mediated by ROS reduction and macrophage skewing
hypotheses.result: Supported but causality not established; associations with ROS-signaling changes observed

title: Tamoxifen targets Wisp2 to impair subcutaneous adipocyte progenitor self-renewal and adipogenic differentiation
task: Elucidate tamoxifen's mechanism in depleting subcutaneous adipocyte progenitors
key_results: Tamoxifen suppresses Wisp2 in obesity-derived adipocyte progenitors; Wisp2 links estrogen signaling to adipocyte progenitor maintenance; Wisp2 loss correlates with impaired self-renewal and differentiation
comments: Direct connection between endocrine therapy and adipocyte progenitor depletion is clinically relevant for T2D risk in breast cancer survivors, though mechanistic details of Wisp2 downstream signaling are limited.

model_io.model: Human and mouse subcutaneous adipose stromal cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tamoxifen suppresses Wisp2 in adipocyte progenitors via estrogen receptor antagonism
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Wisp2 loss follows estrogen signaling disruption

title: Selective blockade of microRNA-31-5p−calcitonin receptor interaction reverses established atrial fibrosis and atrial arrhythmia burden
task: Target miR-31-5p-calcitonin receptor interaction to reverse atrial fibrosis and arrhythmia
key_results: Persistent AF atrial fibroblasts show increased miR-31-5p, reduced CTR; miR-31-5p directly represses CTR and promotes pro-fibrotic responses; fibroblast-specific miR-31 overexpression in mice increases fibrosis and arrhythmia susceptibility; locked nucleic acid blocker restores CTR, prevents fibrosis, reduces arrhythmia burden; reverses established fibrosis in remodeled hearts
comments: Elegant therapeutic approach targeting miRNA-target interaction; selectivity for miR-31-5p-CTR axis may avoid off-target effects of broad miRNA inhibition.

model_io.model: Human atrial fibroblasts; transgenic and WT mice; established atrial remodeling models

hypotheses.hypothesis: miR-31-5p-CTR axis drives atrial fibrosis in AF
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; miR-31-5p overexpression increases fibrosis; selective miR-31-5p-CTR disruption reverses fibrosis and reduces arrhythmias

title: Profiling of pollen in honey using multispectral imaging flow cytometry
task: Identify pollen species in honey using multispectral imaging flow cytometry and machine learning
key_results: CNN/Random Forest classifiers match microscopy accuracy; 3x more pollen evaluated; measurement time ≤10 min for high-throughput screening
comments: Practical automation of melissopalynology with interpretable features, though validation limited to six common pollen types.

model_io.model: MIFC with CNN and Random Forest classification

hypotheses.hypothesis: MIFC with ML matches traditional microscopy for pollen identification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: comparable accuracy achieved with 3x throughput increase

title: A haplotype reference panel constructed from 490,319 UK Biobank genomes improves genotype imputation for global populations
task: Improve genotype imputation across global populations using large reference panel
key_results: UKB panel (490,319 individuals) outperforms TOPMed r3 in phasing for 5 of 6 superpopulations; imputation MAE improved for 4/5 superpopulations; COVID-19 GWAS reimputation enhanced locus discovery
comments: Substantial scale advantage of UKB panel enables better representation of underrepresented populations, particularly East/South Asian groups.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger, more diverse reference panel improves imputation for global populations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: UKB panel superior for most populations; largest gains in East/South Asian groups

title: Identification of ferroptosis-related key genes influencing synovitis development in osteoarthritis based on machine learning
task: Identify ferroptosis-related key genes in osteoarthritis synovitis using machine learning
key_results: CARS identified as key ferroptosis-related gene via SVM model; positive correlation with follicular helper T cell abundance; elevated expression in OA synovial tissue (mRNA and protein)
comments: Multi-algorithm approach with WGCNA identifies plausible candidate, but functional validation remains preliminary and mechanistic role in OA unclear.

inputs: Synovial tissue expression data (32 OA vs 32 controls, GEO)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferroptosis-related genes regulate OA synovitis immune microenvironment
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: CARS correlates with follicular helper T cell infiltration; mechanisms require functional studies

title: Spatial multicellular coordination networks are associated with neoadjuvant immunotherapy response in hepatocellular carcinoma
task: Associate spatial multicellular coordination with immunotherapy response in hepatocellular carcinoma
key_results: Spatial Immune Coordination Index (SICI) shows response separation (Cohen's d=2.40, n=7); malignant-CAF coupling is primary discriminator; modest associations with survival in TCGA-LIHC (n=533)
comments: Sophisticated graph-based framework for quantifying spatial organization, but small discovery cohort and modest bulk validation warrant caution.

inputs: Spatial transcriptomics data from HCC tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial coordination topology associates with immunotherapy response independent of immune abundance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: SICI separates responders from non-responders; malignant-CAF coupling is discriminatory (d=2.40)

title: Hybrid deep feature fusion framework with maximum entropy based selection for accurate diabetic foot ulcer diagnosis from enhanced and segmented medical images
task: Classify diabetic foot ulcers using hybrid deep learning with feature fusion
key_results: AlexNet-MobileNetV2-VGG16 with maximum entropy feature selection achieves 99% AUC, 99.7% sensitivity, 99.5% accuracy
comments: Strong performance metrics reported, but critical details lacking: dataset size, cross-validation strategy, external validation cohort absent.

model_io.model: Hybrid CNN ensemble with feature fusion and selection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid multi-CNN fusion with maximum entropy selection improves DFU classification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: AlexNet-MobileNetV2-VGG16-MESbS achieved 99% AUC

title: Synthesis and in silico evaluation of 1,2,4-triazolo[1,5-a]pyridines in a solvent-free manner over cellulose-based retrievable copper catalyst
task: Synthesize and evaluate 1,2,4-triazolo[1,5-a]pyridines as therapeutic agents
key_results: Nanocatalyst shows high activity and reusability over 5 cycles; compound NTP exhibits highest compatibility with tolmetin via molecular docking; favorable ADMET predictions
comments: Comprehensive in silico evaluation of synthetic compounds, but lacks experimental biological validation of proposed therapeutic potential.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NTP shows optimal drug-like properties and target binding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: NTP highest binding compatibility and favorable ADMET profile

title: Co-retained intron retention on single RNA molecules marks fitness-critical genes
task: Characterize co-retained intron patterns in cancer transcriptomes
key_results: Co-retention occurs with median phi 0.79; co-retained genes enriched for translation and splicing machinery components
comments: Nanopore direct RNA sequencing reveals a previously underexplored layer of post-transcriptional regulation, though functional consequences remain to be established.

inputs: RNA transcripts from six cancer cell lines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Co-retained introns mark fitness-critical genes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: co-retained genes enriched for translation/splicing machinery

title: M4Net for occlusion-robust 3D dense face alignment and cross-subject expression transfer with 3DMM and mask augmentation
task: Perform occlusion-robust 3D dense face alignment with expression transfer
key_results: M4Net achieves 68 points AFLW2000-3D, 21 points AFLW, 0.88% MAEV improvement on occluded data; enables decoupled semantic token transfer
comments: Multi-scale approach with mask augmentation strategy effectively handles occlusion, though generalization to extreme occlusion levels unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mask augmentation improves robustness without increased training cost
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: improved MAEV on occluded AFLW2000-3D

title: Interpretable graph learning of spatial TME patterns in digital pathology for gastric cancer prognosis
task: Predict gastric cancer prognosis from tumor microenvironment spatial architecture
key_results: GTMA Risk Score stratified patients into distinct risk groups within identical TNM stages (cohort n=1871, TCGA-STAD n=213); high-RS tumors show fibroblast-dominant, immune-excluded phenotype
comments: Interpretable graph-based approach captures TME heterogeneity missed by traditional staging, though clinical utility requires prospective validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TME spatial architecture predicts prognosis beyond TNM staging
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: GTMA-RS identified high-risk patients within identical TNM stages

title: A robust Pythagorean fuzzy OPARA decision making approach for evaluating hybrid machine translation in language education
task: Evaluate hybrid machine translation systems using Pythagorean fuzzy MCDM
key_results: PyF-OPARA method identified Hybrid Neural Translator as most appropriate system; demonstrated normalization-free pairwise-adjusted-ratio mechanism preserves original evaluation data properties; sensitivity analysis confirmed ranking stability across parameter variations
comments: Addresses uncertainty in expert judgments but validation limited to single case study with three systems; claimed superiority over existing MCDM approaches lacks direct comparative benchmarking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Normalization-free pairwise-adjusted-ratio mechanism preserves original decision information better than standard normalization
hypotheses.result: supported by comparison with existing MCDM approaches

title: GLTF-FEDformer: an adaptive time-frequency fusion method for multivariate time series anomaly detection enhanced by prediction error embedding
task: Multivariate time series anomaly detection via global-local time-frequency fusion
key_results: GLTF-FEDformer achieved strong detection performance across public datasets with temporal localization ability; outperforms reconstruction-based and attention-based methods in handling complex patterns including long-range dependencies, local dynamic shifts, and transient spectral perturbations
comments: Novel prediction-error-embedded profile strategy captures structural deviations in error distributions, but specific quantitative comparisons and ablation studies on dataset improvements not detailed in abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint modeling of global temporal and local time-frequency features improves anomaly detection in complex patterns
hypotheses.result: confirmed on public datasets with strong performance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Prediction-error-embedded profile captures structural shifts better than point-wise errors alone
hypotheses.result: supported by improved robustness in anomaly scenarios

title: Designing a blockchain-enabled certification framework for food loss and waste reduction: a proof-of-concept in the fresh food supply chain
task: Design blockchain-enabled certification framework for food loss and waste reduction
key_results: Proof-of-concept deployed on Spanish fresh vegetable supply chain using Hyperledger Fabric; demonstrated technical feasibility of automating FLW certification workflows with immutable audit records; identified stakeholder reluctance toward ERP data sharing as primary deployment barrier
comments: Addresses practical certification automation but lacks long-term operational impact assessment; adoption hinges on legal FLW schemes and data governance rather than technical capability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Permissioned blockchain can secure audit record integrity for FLW certification
hypotheses.result: confirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Broader adoption depends on legal certification schemes and data governance
hypotheses.result: confirmed as primary adoption barrier

title: A symmetry breaking swarm optimizer derived from the Landau theory of phase transitions
task: Develop metaheuristic swarm optimizer based on phase transition theory
key_results: SBSO ranked 4th of 12 optimizers on classical benchmark suite; ranked 2nd on five shifted/rotated IEEE CEC blocks; vector generalization enables coordinate-wise adaptive intensity for heterogeneous problems
comments: Theoretical grounding in Landau-Ginzburg free energy and phase transitions is elegant, but performance advantage over state-of-the-art is marginal (runner-up status); benefits mostly on non-separable problems.

outputs: agent search operations via order parameter

hypotheses.hypothesis: Second-order phase transition from Landau-Ginzburg free energy provides superior exploration-exploitation balance versus heuristic schedules
hypotheses.result: supported on rotated/shifted benchmark; separable problems favor simpler collapse methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phase transition mechanism itself (not individual operators) drives performance benefits
hypotheses.result: confirmed by controlled ablations

title: Skillful subseasonal-to-seasonal ensemble forecasting with a multi-sphere coupled probabilistic model
task: Global subseasonal-to-seasonal ensemble forecasting with multi-sphere coupling
key_results: TianXing-S2S outperforms ECMWF S2S and FuXi-S2S on key atmospheric variables in 45-day forecasts at 1.5°×1.5° resolution; improves extreme event prediction (heat waves, anomalous precipitation); enables stable 180-day probabilistic rollout forecasts
comments: Novel optimal transport-based coupling module is key innovation, but quantitative performance gains and comparison metrics not specified; 180-day stability claim needs validation against climatological persistence.

model_io.model: TianXing-S2S (diffusion-based probabilistic model with OT coupling)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-sphere coupling via optimal transport improves S2S forecast skill over single-sphere models
hypotheses.result: confirmed; multi-sphere coupling identified as key contributor to extreme event improvement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diffusion-based ensemble generation provides skillful probabilistic forecasts competitive with operational centers
hypotheses.result: supported by outperformance of ECMWF and FuXi-S2S

title: Observation of quantized charge accumulation in a quantum anomalous Hall system
task: Direct detection of quantized charge accumulation in quantum anomalous Hall systems
key_results: Quantized charge density η0 = (e²/h)ΔB resolved under ultra-low dissipation (σxx ≈ 10⁻⁹ S); out-of-plane capacitive probe validates charge accumulation proportional to field variation
comments: Novel experimental methodology directly probes topological quantization; dissipation model extraction is elegant but assumes clean charge accumulation mechanisms.

model_io.model: Corbino disk quantum anomalous Hall device

hypotheses.hypothesis: Surface charge accumulates quantizedly in quantum anomalous Hall effect
hypotheses.result: Directly confirmed via frequency- and conductance-dependent capacitive measurements

title: The role of solid-melt interfaces in self-catalyzed growth kinetics of III-nitride semiconductors
task: Quantitative prediction of GaN growth kinetics via machine-learning interatomic potentials and solid-melt interface analysis
key_results: Growth rates 0.01–0.04 nm/s predicted without fitting; facet-dependent interface ordering lowers N-transport barriers; diffusion-controlled layer-by-layer growth regime confirmed
comments: Machine-learning potentials enable atomistic accuracy at scale; model generalizability to other III-nitrides is promising but unvalidated experimentally.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Crystal orientation determines melt ordering and N-transport kinetics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: facet-specific free-energy profiles and interface ordering reshape N diffusion landscape

title: Reaching the thermodynamic limit of periodic CCSD cohesive energies and band gaps
task: Convergence of periodic coupled-cluster theory to thermodynamic limit for semiconductors
key_results: Cohesive energies converged to 0.1 eV (errors 0.1–0.2 eV vs experiment); band gaps converged to ~0.4 eV error vs experiment using up to 216 k-points
comments: Distributed-memory implementation enables benchmark-quality calculations; systematic 0.4 eV band gap overestimate suggests persistent CCSD limitations beyond finite-size effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Periodic CCSD errors vanish in thermodynamic limit with sufficient k-point sampling
hypotheses.result: Convergence to 0.1 eV achieved; extrapolated values provide definitive benchmarks for eight semiconductors/insulators

title: Deep subwavelength laser nanofabrication via upconversion
task: Deep subwavelength 3D laser nanofabrication via upconversion nonlinear photon management
key_results: UC-LN decouples fabrication resolution from laser source constraints; enables deep subwavelength 3D structures at lower continuous-wave intensities without femtosecond lasers
comments: Upconversion leverages nonlinear physics elegantly; review position is conceptual rather than demonstrating specific resolution or speed benchmarks vs conventional multiphoton methods.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Upconversion decouples resolution from laser wavelength, enabling subwavelength nanofabrication at low power
hypotheses.result: Proposed as viable alternative; specific resolution and intensity comparisons vs femtosecond methods not quantified

title: Automated inverse design of metainterfaces with tailored friction laws
task: Inverse design framework for metainterfaces with programmable friction laws
key_results: Achieved power-law friction variation (exponents 2/3–1.35), bilinear friction laws with segment-dependent slopes; framework enables exploration of large topography parameter spaces
comments: Numerical-optimization-based design is systematic and scalable; experimental validation demonstrated for selected cases, but practical robustness across material pairs unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Engineered topographies enable arbitrary friction laws without material substitution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: power-law and bilinear laws demonstrated; relevant cases validated experimentally

title: Multiparticle quantum walks in a dipole-conserving Bose–Hubbard model
task: Observation of mobile fracton bound states and quantum walks in dipole-conserving Bose–Hubbard model
key_results: Individual mobile bound states (dipole–antidipole pairs) realized in optical lattice; coherent quantum walks and strongly interacting scattering dynamics characterized
comments: Elegant bottom-up realization of fractonic constraints; site-resolved control enables direct tracking of exotic quasiparticles.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dipole-conserving constraint creates immobile isolated excitations but mobile bound states
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: isolated fractons localized, dipole–antidipole pairs mobile with coherent quantum dynamics

title: Large-area sputtered 2H-MoS2 thin films for spin and orbital charge conversion
task: Large-area MoS2 thin film growth and spin-orbital charge conversion characterization
key_results: RF magnetron sputtering with annealing stabilizes 2H phase; MoS2/Py bilayers show spin pumping signals comparable to Pt/Py; interfacial contribution dominates spin–orbital–charge conversion
comments: Scalable sputtering approach addresses manufacturing challenges, though spin Hall angle quantification relative to Pt would strengthen the claim of competitive performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Annealing stabilizes semiconducting 2H phase in sputtered MoS2
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by Raman, XRD, and electron microscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: MoS2 enables comparable spin-to-charge conversion as Pt
hypotheses.result: MoS2/Py signals are pronounced but MoS2 thickness-independent signal in ternary heterostructure indicates dominant interfacial mechanism

title: Fully-chromophoric ferroelectric nematics for electronic electro-optics
task: Design of fully-chromophoric ferroelectric nematic molecules for electronic electro-optic phase modulation
key_results: EEO coefficient r33 ~ 30 pm/V in PM618 and PM628 mixtures, comparable to lithium niobate; 100% chromophoric active nonlinear medium realized
comments: Elegant molecular design unifies polarity-dependent association and chromophoric nonlinearity; tunability and ease of processing offer device advantages, though long-term stability requires validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Functionalizing nematic rods for both polarity and chromophoric response enables high EEO efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: r33 values match lithium niobate while retaining fluid-phase advantages

title: Learning coupling for pendulum swing-up using physical reservoir control
task: Model-free nonlinear control of torque-limited pendulum via physical reservoir coupling
key_results: Coupled double-pendulum reservoir learns to swing up and balance single pendulum; control robustness to noise and disturbances demonstrated; coupling re-established after signal loss
comments: Physical reservoir control is elegant and bio-inspired; demonstration limited to pendulum system—scalability to higher-dimensional or more complex dynamics unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physical coupling enables model-free nonlinear control via learned dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: swing-up and balance achieved without external model or tuning; robustness to noise and disturbances verified

title: Theoretical anatomy of altermagnetic α-MnTe from magnetism to triple-resistance states
task: Theoretical characterization of altermagnetic α-MnTe magnetism and triple-resistance tunneling states
key_results: Néel temperature 340 K confirmed from Heisenberg exchange; hexagonal planar Néel vector from anisotropies; tunneling magnetoresistance up to ~5300% achieved in magnetic tunnel junctions
comments: Comprehensive symmetry-adaptive tensorial modeling; extraordinary TMR values suggest promising spintronic device potential, though experimental realization of high-resistance states remains to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: α-MnTe exhibits A-type antiferromagnetic order with hexagonal planar Néel vector
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: continuous ground-state degeneracy resolved by anisotropies

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spin-transport matching enables extraordinary tunneling magnetoresistance
hypotheses.result: Achieved: TMR ~5300% in sandwiched junctions via Brillouin zone matching

title: Analysis of 515 human proteomes defines plasma extracellular vesicle core composition, corona and coisolated networks
task: Decompose plasma EV proteome to distinguish biophysical corona from biological co-isolates
key_results: 515 human plasma EV proteomes meta-analyzed; core proteome governed by surface-charge-driven mass-action; three mechanistic origins identified: electrostatic corona, ex vivo platelet vesiculation, and macromolecular co-isolates
comments: Elegant quantitative framework linking synthetic nanoparticle physics to biological EV isolation artifacts, though phlebotomy trauma contribution suggests workflow standardization remains critical for biomarker development.

model_io.model: Plasma EV proteome mass-action corona model

hypotheses.hypothesis: EV core proteome reflects predictable electrostatic mass-action similar to synthetic nanoparticle corona formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reproducible core composition quantitatively matches synthetic corona predictions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phlebotomy-induced platelet trauma contributes significantly to residual vesicular cargo signal
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; residual cargo strongly correlates with thrombin-induced platelet degranulation
